newsitem.title: USA: Bikers Dream CFO Gresher resigns.
newsitem.headline: Bikers Dream CFO Gresher resigns.

text.p: Bikers Dream Inc said William Gresher resigned as chief financial officer. It also said co-chairman Donald Duffy has agreed to assume the duties of chief financial officer.

With the resignation of Gresher, along with the termination of some other employees, the company said its annual overhead was reduced by $750,000. It was not immediately available to say how many other employees had been terminated.
